name: Agent Rollback & Recovery
description: Provides rollback and recovery capabilities for agent deployments. When an agent is compromised, misconfigured, or behaving unexpectedly, RC-01 enables rapid reversion to a known-good state including configuration, tool approvals, and behavioral baselines.
threat_addressed: Compromised or misconfigured agents require rapid recovery to a known-good state. Without rollback capability, recovery involves manual reconstruction of configuration and security state, extending downtime and increasing the window of exposure.
enforcement_mechanism: Maintains versioned snapshots of agent configuration, tool registry, and behavioral baselines. Enables point-in-time recovery to any previous known-good state. Validates recovered configuration against governance policy before reactivation.

security_outcome.pass: Recovery capability active — known-good state snapshots available.
security_outcome.fail: No recovery snapshots available or recovery procedure failed.

display_detail: Maintains recovery snapshots enabling rapid rollback to known-good agent state.
remediation_hint_template: No recovery snapshots available. Enable configuration snapshots to support rollback capability.
